kernel_certificates.label: FINITE_CERTIFICATE
kernel_certificates.claim: Exact algebra of the even cutoff-3 vector (constraints, norm, non-zero fourth moment 2880x, transform closed form), of the endpoint polynomial q (transform (s^2-1/4)^2/s^14, two vanishing moments at 1/2, exactly two sign changes), and of the cutoff-4 profile g and its Volterra square q4 (closed form, g(0)=0, exact double zero of K=(Lg)^2 at 1/2, the constants C0, C1, C2 and the Drive values C_H = 24 C0 + 4 C1, C_H' = 24 C1 + 4 C2). Outward dyadic enclosures give J(4) > 0 and J(6) < 0 for the integer-drive kernel J = H' + H/2.
kernel_certificates.reverified_in_ci: The whole record is recomputed and compared byte for byte (about three seconds).
kernel_certificates.independence: The J enclosures come from an implementation written for this increment; they intersect the enclosures of the Drive note, whose script was not used.
kernel_certificates.limit: Explicit finite objects and two values of one function. The bounds |H| <= C_H (1+t) and |H'| <= C_H' (1+t) are paper derivations of the Drive notes (DERIVED); only their constants are checked here.

drive_scalar_table.label: EXPERIMENTAL_SIGNAL
drive_scalar_table.claim: The eight values of the even cutoff-3 energy E_e(L) printed in the signed-aperture note (mpmath quadrature of the complete prime-side formula) equal the ball-arithmetic prime-side values of evidence/increment6a/SPECTRAL_K3.json to a relative difference below 1e-15 at L = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 10, 12.
drive_scalar_table.limit: Two implementations of one compiled identity agree numerically; this is not a proof of the closed formula and says nothing about late apertures.

not_established: any signed bound on the Mertens or prime discrepancy pairing
